admin_mcp_description: Let MCP clients such as Claude Code read the admin console and change runtime settings and AI models as you. Tokens belong to you only, and the full value is shown once, at creation.
admin_mcp_description_short: Let MCP clients read and write the admin console as you. The full token is shown once, at creation.
admin_mcp_endpoint_hint: Stateless HTTP transport; send Authorization: Bearer <token>. Every call is written to the audit log.
admin_mcp_copy_failed: Copy failed. Select the text and copy it manually
admin_mcp_footnote: Tokens stop working as soon as their owner is demoted or banned. Revoked and expired tokens are removed from this list after 30 days.
admin_mcp_empty_body: Create a token, then add the endpoint above in an MCP client such as Claude Code to let an agent read the admin console and configure models and settings.
admin_mcp_load_failed: Could not load tokens. Reload the page to try again.
admin_mcp_create_description: The token calls MCP tools as you, limited to the scopes selected below.
admin_mcp_scope_read_description: Settings, models, users, orders, credit ledger, audit and metrics, with the same fields as the admin pages
admin_mcp_scope_write_description: Change runtime settings and AI models (with dry-run preview). Cannot refund, adjust credits or delete users
admin_mcp_term_hint: Expires on {date}. Up to {max} days; create a new token after it expires.
admin_mcp_create_failed: Could not create the token. Check the name and expiry, then try again.
admin_mcp_created_warning: The full token is shown only this once. Copy it now and store it in your keychain or password manager; it cannot be viewed again after closing.
admin_mcp_created_warning_short: The full token is shown only this once. Copy and store it now.
admin_mcp_revoke_body: MCP clients using this token lose access immediately. This cannot be undone and is recorded in the audit log.
admin_mcp_revoke_failed: Could not revoke the token. Reload the page and try again.
